IS t 9382 ( Part I ) - 1981 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SEALING RUBBER FOR COVERS 
FOR CARGO HATCHES 

PART I DRY CARGO HATCHES 
0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part I ) was adopted by the Indian Standards 
Institution on 31 July 1981, after the draft finalized by the Inland and 
Harbour Graft Sectional Committee had been approved by the Marine, 
Cargo Movement and Packaging Division Council. 

0.2 This standard is intended to promote the production of reliable seal- 
ing rubber for covers of cargo hatches. 

0.3 The packing is intended to insure water- and weathertightness in 
rectilinear sections along the perimeter and in joints between adjacent 
panels of cargo hatch covers ( see IS : 7048-1973* ). 

0.4 Part J I of this standard shall cover sealing rubber for covers for oil 

barge hatches. 

0.5 Requirements and testing for water- and weathertightness of cargo 
hatch covers are covered in IS : 7048-1973*. 

0.6 This standard is based on ISO 40894979(E) ' Shipbuilding inland 
navigation — Sealing rubber for covers of cargo hatches ', issued by the 
International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard ( Part I ) specifies the type, principal dimensions and 
requirements for the sealing rubber for covers of cargo hatches of various 
types of inland vessels. 

1.2 This standard does not apply to special rubber packings intended to 
create heat-insulating labyrinths. 



♦Specification for small steel square weathertight hatch covers.

2. TYPE AND DIMENSIONS 

2.1 Rectangular sealing rubber shall correspond to the dimensions given 
in Table 1. 

TABLE 1 TYPES AND DIMENSIONS OF PACKINGS 

All dimensions in millimetres. 

Dimensional 
Type

4 
5 

Note — h — height, and 
w — width. 

2.2 The packing groove may have either a rectangular or a trapezoidal 
section. 

3. REQUIREMENTS 

3.1 The sealing rubber shall recover its original shape after compression 
of 8 ± 2 mm by a packing rim ( a strip of thickness up to 20 mm or a 
bar of diameter up to 30 mm ) for 1 month. 

3.1.1 The value of the residual deformation shall be minimum and 
shall not impair the tightness of the sealing rubber. 

3.2 The sealing rubber shall ensure weather- and watertightness without 
losing its physical and mechanical properties as given in IS : 3400 
(Part I to XX )-1977* within the temperature range from —30 to 
+ 77°C. 

3.3 The sealing rubber shall be oil resistant. 

3.4 The sealing rubber working areas and the areas which are exposed 
to the influence of the external surroundings shall be resistant to both 
sunlight and ozone when determined in accordance with IS : 3400 
(PartXX)-1977t. 

3.5 The grade of rubber used shall permit reliable glueing, vulcanization 
or other methods of connecting the separate elements of the packing to 
one another and their fixation in the grooves of the sections of a hatch 
cover. 



♦Methods of test for vulcanized rubbers. 

•(■Methods of test for vulcanized rubbers: Part XX Resistance to ozone.
